screens.content: The community garden is ordering seeds for the spring beds. Tomato packets cost $12.50 each, and the committee has set aside a 20% reserve for tools and unexpected repairs. Nia reads the supplier list while Omar counts the packets requested by each volunteer. They notice that the herb plot needs fewer seeds than planned, so they move that amount to the bean bed instead. At the meeting, Nia explains the change, records the revised total, and asks everyone to check the quantities before the order is sent.
